🚨 Must-Read Before Getting ‘Onda Lifting’ in Korea! (How to Boost Results by 200%)
Are you just lying there during your Onda Lifting? 🙅‍♀️ You might not see any results that way!
Remember these 3 things before you go to the clinic!
✅ POINT 1. Lift your chin all the way up!
The Onda tip (handpiece) is bigger than you think.
You need to lift your chin as high as possible for the energy to make perfect contact with your skin. Especially if you don’t have much double chin fat,
you need to lift high to definitely get the #Tightening and #FatDestruction effects you want! 🔥
✅ POINT 2. Turn your head side to side!
With Onda, the heat rises as the energy builds up.
If it stays in one spot, it can get too hot!
Show some sense by turning your head left and right (while keeping your chin up!)
to help the energy spread evenly over a wider area👀
✅ POINT 3. Wear a low-neckline top (Pro Tip 🍯)
We use ‘Jojoba Oil’ during the Onda procedure.
High-neck tops are inconvenient because you’ll have to get changed. If you come wearing a top that exposes your neckline, you can get the treatment comfortably right away without changing clothes or worrying about oil getting on them! 👚
Save this post and make sure to check it before your appointment! 💾

🚨 Must-Read Before Getting ‘Onda Lifting’ in Korea! (How to Boost Results by 200%)
Are you just lying there during your Onda Lifting? 🙅‍♀️ You might not see any results that way!
Remember these 3 things before you go to the clinic!
✅ POINT 1. Lift your chin all the way up!
The Onda tip (handpiece) is bigger than you think.
You need to lift your chin as high as possible for the energy to make perfect contact with your skin. Especially if you don’t have much double chin fat,
you need to lift high to definitely get the #Tightening and #FatDestruction effects you want! 🔥
✅ POINT 2. Turn your head side to side!
With Onda, the heat rises as the energy builds up.
If it stays in one spot, it can get too hot!
Show some sense by turning your head left and right (while keeping your chin up!)
to help the energy spread evenly over a wider area👀
✅ POINT 3. Wear a low-neckline top (Pro Tip 🍯)
We use ‘Jojoba Oil’ during the Onda procedure.
High-neck tops are inconvenient because you’ll have to get changed. If you come wearing a top that exposes your neckline, you can get the treatment comfortably right away without changing clothes or worrying about oil getting on them! 👚
Save this post and make sure to check it before your appointment! 💾

Thermage đã trải qua nhiều thế hệ phát triển nhằm nâng cao hiệu quả điều trị và tối ưu trải nghiệm cho khách hàng. Trong đó, Thermage CPT và Thermage FLX đều sử dụng công nghệ Monopolar Radiofrequency (RF) để kích thích tăng sinh collagen. Tuy nhiên, Thermage FLX được phát triển với nhiều cải tiến đáng kể về công nghệ và quy trình điều trị.
Điểm khác biệt đầu tiên nằm ở hệ thống phân phối năng lượng.
Thermage FLX được tích hợp công nghệ AccuREP™, có khả năng đo lường trở kháng của từng vùng da theo thời gian thực và tự động điều chỉnh mức năng lượng phù hợp trong suốt quá trình điều trị. Nhờ đó, năng lượng được phân bố đồng đều và chính xác hơn trên từng vùng da.
Trong khi đó, Thermage CPT sử dụng mức năng lượng được thiết lập trước và chưa được trang bị khả năng phân tích, điều chỉnh năng lượng theo đặc điểm mô của từng bệnh nhân như Thermage FLX.
Một cải tiến quan trọng khác là đầu điều trị Total Tip 4.0 cm².
So với thế hệ CPT, đầu tip mới có diện tích lớn hơn, giúp mở rộng vùng điều trị trong mỗi xung, từ đó rút ngắn thời gian thực hiện mà vẫn đảm bảo số lượng xung theo chỉ định của bác sĩ.
Bên cạnh đó, Thermage FLX cũng được cải tiến về hệ thống rung và làm mát Comfort Pulse Technology™, giúp quá trình điều trị trở nên dễ chịu hơn, giảm cảm giác khó chịu trong khi vẫn duy trì hiệu quả truyền nhiệt đến lớp mô đích.
Mặc dù Thermage CPT và Thermage FLX đều hoạt động dựa trên cùng nguyên lý sử dụng Monopolar RF để kích thích tái cấu trúc collagen, Thermage FLX mang đến những cải tiến về độ chính xác, khả năng cá nhân hóa năng lượng và trải nghiệm điều trị, đáp ứng tốt hơn nhu cầu trẻ hóa da hiện đại.
🏆 Tại phòng khám của Dr. Anna Khanh, mỗi khách hàng đều được bác sĩ trực tiếp đánh giá tình trạng lão hóa, chất lượng làn da và chỉ định liệu trình Thermage FLX phù hợp. Điều trị đúng chỉ định, đúng công nghệ và đúng thời điểm là nền tảng để đạt hiệu quả trẻ hóa an toàn, tự nhiên và bền vững.

Thermage has evolved through several generations to enhance treatment efficacy while improving patient comfort. Both Thermage CPT and Thermage FLX utilize Monopolar Radiofrequency (RF) technology to stimulate collagen production. However, Thermage FLX introduces several technological advancements that optimize treatment precision and the overall patient experience.
One of the most significant improvements is its energy delivery system.
Thermage FLX features AccuREP™ technology, which measures tissue impedance in real time and automatically adjusts the energy output according to the characteristics of each treatment area. This allows for more precise, consistent, and personalized energy delivery throughout the procedure.
In comparison, Thermage CPT delivers a preset level of energy and does not incorporate real-time tissue analysis or automatic energy optimization.
Another key advancement is the Total Tip 4.0 cm² treatment tip.
Compared with the previous CPT generation, the larger treatment tip covers a greater surface area with each pulse, helping reduce treatment time while maintaining the recommended number of treatment pulses.
Thermage FLX also incorporates an enhanced Comfort Pulse Technology™ system, combining vibration and integrated cooling to improve patient comfort during treatment while maintaining effective heat delivery to the targeted collagen-rich tissue.
Although both Thermage CPT and Thermage FLX are based on the same principle of using Monopolar RF to stimulate collagen remodeling, Thermage FLX offers greater treatment precision, more personalized energy delivery, and a more comfortable treatment experience, making it well suited to the evolving demands of non-invasive skin rejuvenation.
🏆 At Dr. Anna Khanh's clinic, every Thermage FLX treatment begins with a comprehensive physician-led assessment of your skin quality and degree of facial aging. Selecting the right technology, at the right time, and with the appropriate treatment protocol is essential to achieving safe, natural-looking, and long-lasting rejuvenation.

ads.copy:
🇰🇷 韓國 SMILE Pro 只要台灣半價？揭密 10 秒雷射的真相！！！​大家最近是不是一直被 #韓國雷射 洗版？除了價格甜到不可思議，到底跟台灣的技術有什麼差別？今天幫大家整理了這份 #SMILEPro 終極懶人包，看完再決定要不要買機票！✈️
​🔍 為什麼選 SMILE Pro (VisuMax 800)？
簡單說，它是雷射界的法拉利，比起舊款 SMILE 有三大升級：
1️⃣ 超快速度 (Speed)： 單眼雷射時間從傳統的 25 秒縮短到 「8-10 秒」！根據臨床數據，這大幅降低了眼睛亂動導致失敗的風險。
2️⃣ 解決散光 (Astigmatism)： 這是最有感的升級！內建 OcuLign 智慧導航，如果你躺下時眼球旋轉，雷射會自動轉向追蹤。數據顯示，散光矯正的精準度因此大幅提升，不再只靠醫師憑感覺。
3️⃣ 恢復神速 (Recovery)： 傷口只有 2mm (筆尖大小)，保留了角膜強度。研究顯示 92% 的人術後 3 個月視力都在 1.0 以上。
​💰 價格大比拼 (台幣預估)
這也是大家最關心的！為什麼韓國這麼便宜？因為江南區的診所採用「工廠化」經營，量大成本低，且價格透明競爭。
🇹🇼 台灣： 約 8-14 萬 TWD
🇰🇷 韓國： 約 5-9.5 萬 TWD
👉 現省 3-4 萬！ 這筆錢拿來買機票、住飯店、吃醬蟹還有找！
​⚠️ 去韓國雷射的風險評估 (非常重要！必看！)
雖然 CP 值高，但醫療沒有 100% 的：
​術後回診難： 萬一回到台灣眼睛發炎，台灣醫師可能無法調閱韓國的手術數據，處理起來比較麻煩。
​術前停戴隱眼： 軟式至少 1 週，硬式 2-3 週。這點絕對不能偷懶，不然檢查數據不準，雷射打偏就慘了！
​隱形收費： 有些低價廣告不含藥水費或指定院長費，預約前要問清楚「Full Package Price」。
​💡 醫師怎麼看？
如果你是高度散光、容易緊張（怕痛、怕眼睛張不久）的人，SMILE Pro 的 10秒雷射 與 AI 輔助 絕對是首選。至於是留在台灣享受完整售後，還是飛韓國省錢，就看大家對風險的接受度囉！

Finish it all at once with Dr. Hyunjun Yoon 🌷
At HERSHE Plastic Surgery, our Double Chin Removal Surgery with Double Chin Muscle Tightening and Mini Jawline Lift Surgery by Dr. Hyunjun Yoon focuses on improving the root causes of a heavy lower face and unclear jawline.
By addressing excess fat, deep fat layers, sagging tissues, and muscle laxity step by step, the procedure helps create a firmer, smoother, and more naturally defined jawline.
The Mini Jawline Lift Surgery involves sufficient skin detachment, lifting of the SMAS layer, and removal of excess skin to improve sagging skin and create a more lifted lower face contour while maintaining natural facial balance 🌷

▫ Refines a sagging jawline and double chin area
▫ Creates a smoother transition between the face and neck line
▫ Helps improve a heavier or tired lower face appearance
▫ Creates a firmer and more sculpted jawline contour
A natural transformation designed to remain refined, balanced, and naturally lifted over time 💕

Every face has its own unique anatomy, soft tissue quality, and aging pattern. For this reason, before recommending Thermage FLX, the Specialist Level I physicians at Dr. Anna Khanh's Clinic perform a comprehensive facial assessment rather than applying the same treatment protocol to every client.
For this client from Russia, the physicians carefully evaluated several key factors, including skin quality, elasticity, the degree of skin laxity, facial contours, and volume distribution across different facial regions. These assessments help identify the underlying causes of facial aging and determine the most appropriate treatment strategy.
Based on the assessment, the medical team concluded that Thermage FLX was a suitable option to improve skin firmness, stimulate natural collagen remodeling, and enhance facial definition while maintaining a natural appearance. The goal was not to alter the client's facial features, but to improve tissue quality and restore a fresher, more youthful look.
Rather than focusing solely on the number of treatment pulses or isolated facial areas, the physicians developed a personalized Thermage FLX treatment plan based on the client's individual anatomy. Every energy delivery line was strategically planned to optimize skin tightening results while maintaining facial harmony and balance.
According to the medical team, the success of Thermage FLX depends not only on advanced technology but also on accurate facial assessment, clinical expertise, and a personalized treatment strategy. This is why every treatment at Dr. Anna Khanh's Clinic is tailored to the unique aging characteristics of each individual instead of following a standardized protocol.
✨ For this client from Russia, Thermage FLX was more than a skin-tightening procedure. It was a personalized rejuvenation plan designed through detailed facial analysis, aiming to achieve natural-looking, safe, and long-lasting results.
